verdict.rationale: The only MCP evidence describes the opposite direction: external assistants such as ChatGPT or Claude connecting to NetHunt, which is the MCP-server role. Nothing shows NetHunt itself acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers and uses their tools. Webhooks, automations and an OpenAPI spec are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
